integrity: The governing equations, parameter example, equilibrium and delay-induced periodic context were reconstructed from the publisher full text. The proof uses exact period integration and two elementary rational identities; the bundled checker verifies the algebra and exact numerical specialization. Originality assessment is search-limited and does not constitute a proof that no equivalent statement exists anywhere.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a necessary identity for strictly positive periodic solutions of the printed delayed logistic/additive-predation model. It does not establish existence, uniqueness, orbital stability, Hopf direction, basin geometry, or any statement for the boundary periodic solutions with zero predator density or for general nonperiodic recurrence.
title: Delay-invariant period means and an exact phase–yield law under additive predation
